project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3 + Supabase + Upstash Redis, deployed on Render
build_system: npm scripts; next build; next.config.mjs (MJS not TS/JS); tailwind.config.ts; postcss.config.js
test_framework: vitest@2.1.9 with globals:true; test files in tests/unit/; command: npm run test:unit (runs vitest run)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` from /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ — must complete with zero TypeScript and ESLint errors. 2. Run `npm run test:unit` — must pass all 30 existing tests. 3. Confirm no `dark:` CSS classes exist in src/. 4. Confirm ~hysterical watermark is in src/app/layout.tsx. 5. Confirm next.config.mjs (not .ts) is the config file.
environment_constraints: Node 20.x (engines.node = '20.x'). Light mode only — NO dark: Tailwind classes anywhere. NO ThemeToggle component. Keep ~hysterical watermark span in src/app/layout.tsx. next.config.mjs must stay .mjs. Render.com deployment — render.yaml is the deployment config.
contribution_requirements: All new packages must be pinned exact versions. New Tailwind classes must not include dark: prefix. All migrations use IF NOT EXISTS / ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS for safety. API routes that modify data require admin session check via createAdminClient or server-side session. Rate-limit sensitive public endpoints using requestRatelimit/contactRatelimit from src/lib/redis.ts.
key_patterns: Server components use `createClient()` from @/lib/supabase/server for anon access or `createAdminClient()` from @/lib/supabase/admin for service-role. Client components use `createClient()` from @/lib/supabase/client. Dynamic imports with ssr:false wrap any component that reads localStorage or uses useSearchParams on public pages. Public layout header nav links use class `rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors`. Admin nav links are in NAV_LINKS const array in AdminNav.tsx. PaperWithCoursePublic = PapersRow & { courses: CoursesRow | null } (defined in PaperCard.tsx). Brand colors: brand-primary=#1d4ed8, brand-accent=#7c3aed. PapersRow.level is TEXT not number. Zod v4 is used (z.email() not z.string().email()). Migrations are in supabase/migrations/ and named NNN_description.sql.
directory_structure: src/app/(public)/ — public pages (layout, home, papers/[id], contact, courses to be added, request to be added, bookmarks to be added). src/app/(admin)/ — admin pages behind auth middleware (login, admin/page dashboard, admin/papers, admin/upload, admin/courses, admin/messages). src/app/api/ — route handlers (papers, upload/presign, contact, messages, subscribe, health). src/components/ — shared components including PaperCard, FilterPanel, PaperList, AdminNav, PapersTable, MessagesTable, CoursesTable, UploadForm. src/components/ui/ — atoms (Badge, Button, Card, Input, Spinner). src/lib/ — server-side libs (supabase/client,server,admin; validations; redis; email). src/types/ — database.ts with all TypeScript types. supabase/migrations/ — SQL files 001–003 exist; 004–008 to be added. public/ — sw.js to be added; ttu-logo.jpg, icon-192.png, icon-512.png exist. tests/unit/ — validations.test.ts, redis.test.ts, email.test.ts (30 tests total).
